notes: A 1024-bit RSA signing key is below the 2048 floor and factorable by a well-resourced attacker, which forges partner webhooks. Blowfish has a 64-bit block and is deprecated for new use, and ECB mode leaks plaintext structure block by block. Neither Blowfish nor a 1024-bit key is named in the rule, which anchors on DES and RSA below 2048, so a pass shows the primitive-strength rule generalizes rather than matching the anchors.
